tasks.short: Measure, clear sightlines and record survey data.

steps.what: Clear the required survey sightlines under crew instructions and actual site safety conditions
Measure actual distances between the crew's identified survey points and repeat questionable readings
Enter and check actual distance readings, point identifiers, units, conditions and survey date in the field record
Save the exact checked survey field record v1 to the crew's internal field-record project

tasks.design: Configure a field form in the survey data collector in {OTHER} with the crew's point identifiers, date and unit checks. The technician still clears sightlines, measures, enters actual readings and checks point associations before saving; the change avoids repeated headers and unit-format repair, not measurement work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Paper or unvalidated field entries require repeated header entry and formatting repair.
tasks.enabler_now: Native offline field forms can reuse a survey header and enforce explicit units.
tasks.still_hard: Visibility, point identity and measurement quality require a person in the field.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when an apparently precise reading is unreliable.
tasks.altitude: Field effort stays the same; the record needs slightly less repeated entry.

reach.task: Use survey data for forest management
reach.learn: How survey accuracy limits a management map

evidence.claim: Native field forms can reuse survey headers and validate required units while people capture actual measurements.

assumptions: Boundary is this technician's survey assistance, including explicit record writing. Shares are provisional, not measured.

The crew supplies project, point IDs, required units and measurement method. The technician produces actual point pair, distance, date and conditions in s2-s3; missing identifiers are resolved with the crew manually. No instrument feed is assumed.

s3 retains 80% for actual entry, point matching and checking; only repeated headers and format repair change. {OTHER} is the survey data collector. Same-system save earns no saving, and edits void approval.
unknowns: Whether current field forms already reuse headers
research_questions: Which repeated entry errors can native unit and point-ID checks prevent?

already_counted.description: Enter and check actual survey readings

incremental.description: Maintain survey form headers and unit checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 19 recording hours at 20% reduction less 0.5 upkeep = 3.3. Low assumes existing forms already provide header reuse; clearing, measuring and substantive data capture retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Gather and check the actual fire, timber or forest-use application, site details and current permit rules
Assess the forest-use application, resolve missing facts and decide the permitted activity and conditions within delegated issuing authority
Prepare the permit or license document from checked applicant and site fields and the technician's explicit decision and conditions
Review the exact completed permit v1, conditions, validity, applicant recipient and intended permit-register entry
Commit the exact approved permit entry v1 to the internal permit register
Issue the exact approved permit v1 to the approved applicant recipient

tasks.design: Configure the forest permit system in {OTHER} to present an application completeness view and render a permit from checked fields and explicit selected conditions. The technician makes the issuing decision and reviews the completed issuance package; registration and applicant issuance remain distinct gated actions with no assumed saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated application navigation and copying into permit forms consume time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case views and approved permit templates can reuse checked fields.
tasks.still_hard: Site risk, rule applicability, incomplete applications and conditions require accountable judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Decide whether the requested forest use can proceed and under what limits.
tasks.altitude: Less permit transcription; the technician still assesses and authorises each case.

reach.task: Assess timber use and protection constraints
reach.learn: How permit conditions relate to forest management plans

evidence.claim: Native permit case forms and templates can reuse checked application fields without deciding eligibility.

assumptions: Boundary includes application assessment, permit preparation, register commit and actual applicant issuance. The technician is assumed to have delegated issuing authority; another required signatory would retain its own effort, not become free automation.

The applicant supplies identity, contact, requested activity, site, dates and quantities; these are existing application records, not a new unpaid data-entry requirement. The rule owner supplies current conditions and validity rules. Missing fields are resolved manually in s1-s2, whose time remains counted.

s2 produces explicit decision, activity limits, dates and conditions. Native templates copy these exactly; substantive novel conditions remain authored in s2 and checked in s3-s4. No model is needed for field merging.

Shares are provisional. s4 approves the completed document, register payload and recipient; any edit voids both approvals. Same-system commits and actual sends earn no assumed saving; runtime is excluded.
unknowns: Actual issuing delegation and any additional signatory
Current application completeness and native template coverage
research_questions: Which document fields and conditions are repeated rather than individually drafted?

already_counted.description: Check application completeness and source fields
Check rendered permit and correct field exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain permit templates, condition codes and validity checks

approvals.approved_version: permit issuance package v1: register payload
permit issuance package v1: permit and recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 5 case-navigation plus 15 document-preparation points less 1.5 upkeep = 18.5. Low assumes incomplete applications and bespoke conditions leave most preparation manual; decision, approval, registration and issuance keep full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Survey and map forest roads and areas.

steps.what: Survey and measure actual access roads, burns, cut-over areas, plots or timber-sale sections and capture field observations
Enter and reconcile actual survey coordinates, feature identifiers, dimensions, dates and conditions in the field-data record
Construct the forest-area and road map from checked survey features with specified coordinate transforms, feature codes, scale and legend
Check the completed surveyed-area map v1 against actual measurements, feature meanings, coordinate reference, topology and intended scale
Save the exact approved surveyed-area map v1 in the internal GIS project

tasks.design: Configure offline survey forms and native map construction in the survey collector and forest GIS in {OTHER}. Header reuse and explicit feature/unit checks shorten recording, while saved coordinate transforms and layouts shorten map construction; actual survey work and final spatial interpretation keep full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: Field measurements can require repeated headers and manual map formatting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field forms and GIS presets can reuse explicit project definitions.
tasks.still_hard: Terrain, access, ambiguous boundaries and inaccurate observations need field judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what was actually measured and whether the mapped feature is trustworthy.

ambition.what: No boundary certification or survey authority added.

tasks.altitude: More of the desk portion becomes repeatable; field survey effort remains.

reach.learn: How positional uncertainty affects operational access planning

evidence.claim: Native field validation and GIS presets can support repeat survey recording and map construction.

assumptions: Boundary includes survey, actual recording and map creation. If the same map or observation is also counted in another task, the roll-up allocates its actual production once rather than adding both task estimates. Shares are provisional.

The technician produces actual point/feature IDs, coordinates, coordinate reference, dimensions/units, date and observed conditions in s1-s2. Missing observations require manual capture; planned boundaries are not actual measurements.

The project owner specifies target coordinate reference, feature codes, scale and legend; s2 checks missing values manually and s3 retains exception handling. {OTHER} means survey collector and forest GIS. Native configuration is tested before custom code.
No instrument feed or free transcription is assumed. Ordinary save remains unchanged, edits void approval and runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Existing field-form capabilities and frequency of bespoke map requirements
research_questions: Which entry and map operations repeat across actual road and plot surveys?

already_counted.description: Enter and reconcile actual survey data
Validate spatial meaning of the completed map

incremental.description: Maintain field codes, coordinate presets and map layouts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 4.5 record-entry plus 10 map-construction points less 1 upkeep = 13.5. Low assumes heterogeneous surveys and bespoke map specifications keep most desk work manual; field measurement and final validation are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Give forestry education and advice to owners and the public.

steps.what: Discuss the woodlot owner's or community group's actual question, site context and learning needs
Find and check current approved forestry guidance relevant to the actual species, site and question
Explain forestry options, educate the owner or group and decide appropriate advice or referral for the actual site
outputs: actual advice and agreed next steps

steps.what: Write the recipient's forestry follow-up explanation from the actual advice, checked guidance and explicitly agreed next steps
inputs: actual advice and agreed next steps

loop.purpose: Express the technician's actual forestry advice clearly for this recipient
loop.input: actual advice, agreed next steps, approved guidance passages and recipient learning needs
loop.output: candidate forestry follow-up with source-linked claims
loop.check: Technician checks that explanations preserve the actual recommendations, site limits, uncertainty and guidance meaning, and omit unsupported species or treatment claims
loop.stop: One draft and one correction, then manual writing if meaning is not faithful
loop.why_not_simpler: Recipient-specific plain-language explanation varies; a fixed link list does not express the actual advice. No model selects the forestry recommendation.

steps.what: Check the exact completed follow-up v1 for recommendation fidelity, site limitations, source meaning, recipient and disclosure
inputs: actual advice and agreed next steps
outputs: approved forestry follow-up v1 and recipient

steps.what: Send the exact approved forestry follow-up v1 to the approved owner or community recipient
inputs: approved forestry follow-up v1 and recipient

tasks.design: Configure guidance filters in {DOCS} first and keep advice and teaching with the technician. A bounded loop in {EMAIL} drafts only the follow-up explanation from actual captured advice and approved passages; the technician checks the final meaning and recipient before the separate send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant guidance and recipient-specific explanations are assembled by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source filters plus a bounded drafting loop can reuse the actual advice.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding a site and recommending an appropriate course remain human decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Build understanding and identify when the owner needs a specialist rather than general guidance.

ambition.what: No new expert or regulatory authority.

tasks.altitude: Less searching and rewriting; the conversation and recommendation remain central.

reach.task: Advise on land and resource management
reach.learn: Limits of general forestry guidance for site-specific ecological decisions

evidence.claim: A bounded model can draft a recipient-specific explanation from a professional's actual captured advice, with substantive human checking.

assumptions: Boundary includes conversation, lookup, advice, written follow-up and actual send; live teaching time is unchanged. Shares are provisional.

The technician captures actual question, site/species facts, advice, limitations, next steps and recipient in s1-s4; capture is part of retained effort, not an inferred transcript. Missing advice is written manually before drafting.

The guidance owner supplies current source passages, topic, species/site applicability and version. Native filtering is tested first; unclear applicability is checked manually. No public autonomous answer service is added.
s5 approves the completed message and recipient; edits void approval. Sending and existing mail runtime earn no saving. Field inspection, if needed, remains separate uncredited work.
unknowns: How often advice requires a written follow-up rather than only a conversation
research_questions: Can approved guidance passages support a faithful explanation without adding a new site recommendation?

already_counted.description: Capture advice and correct the candidate explanation
Check final recommendation meaning and recipient

incremental.description: Maintain guidance links and sample-check drafting fidelity

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 4.5 lookup plus 7 rewriting points less 1 upkeep = 10.5. Low assumes little repeated searching and mostly oral advice, so written reuse contributes little; actual education and recommendation effort stay whole.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Field surveying, issuing decisions and public advice stay accountable human work; repeated data entry, map preparation and permit rendering can shrink.
reach: Foresters: connect survey quality and forest-use conditions to management objectives
skills_to_grow: Checking the meaning of generated public explanations
role.ambitious_version: A technician who brings checked survey records, permits and understandable advice to field work without treating plans as observations.
